purpose: Measurement foundation for the FRAMING TEST (world-model vs blank-slate; stateful-core Arm A blank vs Arm B KB-grounded). Records whether a clean KNOWLEDGE-DEPENDENT vs TEXT-SUFFICIENT construction can be BUILT and VALIDATED as the framing-test measurement.

self_tests_pass.valence_shortcut_blocked: 20/20 (fact_id,candidate-word) pairs carry BOTH labels via the causal/noncausal 2x2 cross -> no candidate word deterministically predicts label
self_tests_pass.note: The KD/TS item split, leak-proof fact holdout, and valence-shortcut immunity are all clean; the construction itself is well-formed.

corrected_gate_logic: A text-only reader SHOULD fail KD items (that is what makes them knowledge-dependent). Gate A = KNOWLEDGE-AUGMENTED reader passes KD (acc>=0.65); Gate A' = text-only reader passes TS (acc>=0.65); Gate B = (KD_aug - KD_plain)>=0.10 AND (TS_aug - TS_plain)<=0.05; Gate C = random-init encoder fails KD_aug (worst-case margin<0.05, >=5 seeds).
measured_primary_reader: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 MEAN_POOL, mean over 3 fact-holdout splits [90001,424242,987654], eval N=96 KD + 96 TS per split
finding: MEASUREMENT-LIMIT. Even with the real KB bridge fact INJECTED into the input, the diagnostic known reader (BGE-small / MiniLM) + linear probe over frozen mean-pooled embeddings CANNOT solve the knowledge-dependent items (KD_aug acc 0.53, ~chance). The KB fact does NOT selectively lift KD (lift +0.05, below the +0.10 gate) and actively HURTS TS (-0.11, the extra sentence perturbs the pooled embedding). The bottleneck is the READER'S inability to perform the 2-step conditional bridging inference the construction requires (read action-clause -> is it causal? -> combine with world-fact -> judge claim-consistency) -- a composition a linear readout over pooled sentence embeddings fundamentally cannot express, EVEN when the bridge fact is present in the text. Injecting a fact cannot rescue a reasoning-composition bottleneck.
implication_for_framing_test: The framing test's calibration prerequisite (design-doc D3: 'a knowledge-augmented reader must beat a text-only reader on the knowledge-dependent items, else the construction can't express a world-model advantage') is UNMEETABLE with linear-probe diagnostic readers, because those readers cannot do bridging inference over pooled embeddings at all. A construction whose knowledge-dependence IS expressible to a pooled-embedding linear reader would reduce to a lexical-association cue -- i.e. NOT genuine bridging inference -- defeating the purpose. So the clean knowledge-dependent construction CAN be built (this one is), but it CANNOT be calibration-validated with the available known-reader apparatus. This is itself informative for the framing test: the discriminating signature the world-model hypothesis predicts (KB helps concentrated on bridging items) can only be measured by a reader capable of the bridge -- which the stateful core aspires to BE, not a frozen linear probe. The framing A/B ablation must therefore judge Arm B vs Arm A DIRECTLY on the KD items, WITHOUT a known-reader gate-B precondition on those items (there is no known linear-probe reader that can serve as the positive control for bridging inference).
